summary: Backend regression for the new Points+ History and Money-Spent-on-Multipliers charts on GET /api/admin/players/{player_id}/charts. Added /app/backend/tests/test_admin_player_charts.py with 9 pytest cases — all pass. Verified: 403 for non-admin, 404 for unknown player, original fields preserved (xp/gifted_xp/penalty_xp/goal_xp/tasks/by_area), new top-level boost_spend_currency, per-day boosts_active list with {type, multiplier, duration_days, label, entry_id}, multi-day timeline (double_week spans 7 consecutive days; double_day with activated_at=D-3 / expires_at=D shows on 4 days), boost_spend bucketed by acquired_at and summing ONLY source in (purchase, stripe), legacy purchase entries without paid_amount fallback to current boost_pricing.effective_price, and POST /api/boosts/purchase now snapshots paid_amount + paid_currency on the new boost_inventory entry. No regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 10,269 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Splitting routers into modules (admin, boosts, charts, auth) would help long-term maintainability, but it's a structural refactor not blocking this feature.
seed_data_creation: Test seeds 5 controlled boost_inventory entries directly on the admin profile (tagged with TEST_charts_<uuid> so they are pulled out in teardown), and snapshots+restores boost_pricing rows for triple_day/double_day/double_week/double_month. Non-admin user is registered fresh via /api/auth/register with a randomized gmail.com email (the backend MX-validates domains so example.com is rejected — captured in the test fixture).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend MX-validates email domains on /api/auth/register — use real domains like gmail.com when creating throwaway accounts. Charts test seeds directly into MongoDB; the user_id under test is the admin's own profile to avoid spinning up a second activated player. boost_inventory entries are tagged with _test_tag for safe teardown. boost_pricing is snapshotted before mutation and fully restored at teardown.
